sources.title: Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the exact original 8B Instruct card specifies nominal 8B/70B pretrained and instruction-tuned variants. It identifies the tuned versions as SFT/RLHF alignment of the transformer language models and retains text-only input/output. No pruning, distillation, expert expansion or modality addition is documented for this original Instruct variant.

sources.title: Introducing Meta Llama 3
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: Meta’s April 18, 2024 release explicitly offers pretrained and instruction-fine-tuned 8B/70B models with a decoder-only transformer and GQA. The Instruction fine-tuning section describes post-training the pretrained models using SFT, rejection sampling, PPO and DPO; it does not describe a structural conversion.

sources.title: Original Llama 3 reference model implementation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 through the raw official source: the shared original TransformerBlock executes dense attention and FeedForward modules; FeedForward directly computes SwiGLU projections. No expert router, pruning path or added modality module changes the original Instruct model’s execution structure.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Names the original Llama 3 community license and April 18, 2024 version release. Covers trained weights, permits use and redistribution subject to custom terms, and incorporates an acceptable-use policy.

sources.title: Original Llama 3 release and inference README
sources.evidence: Includes original 8B Instruct download and inference instructions, confirms weight distribution subject to license acceptance, and explicitly says all original models support sequences up to 8192 tokens. Chat formatting lists system, user and assistant roles.

sources.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models, Table 1
sources.evidence: The retrospective table explicitly distinguishes original Llama 3 8B Instruct (April 2024; Tool use absent) from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (July 2024; Tool use present). The caption states that the paper’s performance results are for Llama 3.1, so later capabilities are not transferred.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration (gated)
sources.evidence: The configuration request returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized. No gate bypass, weight download, or precise tensor-derived parameter claim was attempted.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 6: original Llama-3-8B Base activated parameters
sources.evidence: Freshly read October 27: Table 6 identifies Llama-3-8B as Base and Dense, with 8B in both the Total Params and Activated Params rows. This is Qwen’s nominal benchmark convention for the original base model, not a Meta active-count disclosure or a direct Instruct measurement. The separate 8B Instruct comparison in Table 18 is Llama-3.1 and is not substituted for original Llama 3.

sources.title: Qwen2 Technical Report, Table 8: exact original Llama-3-8B-Instruct comparison
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-Instruct search found Table 8 explicitly identifies Llama-3-8B-Instruct in its caption, but reports benchmark scores without an activated-parameter column. It does not directly establish an active count.

sources.title: Yuan2.0-M32 official model card, computational utilization comparison
sources.evidence: Fresh search found section 3.2 explicitly lists Llama3-8B at 8B total and 8B Active Params. Its benchmark scores match original Instruct values, but the comparison label omits Base/Instruct, so this only corroborates the nominal convention and is not treated as an exact checkpoint identification.

name.note: The display name matches the exact original checkpoint and retrospective table row.

developer.note: The exact card names Meta as model developer.

family.note: Original April 2024 Llama 3 release; distinct from Llama 3.1.

release_date.note: The exact card, dated release announcement and license explicitly agree on April 18, 2024.

open_weights.note: Original trained weights are distributed under Meta’s custom license, with gated access requiring acceptance.

license.note: Supported short name for the Meta Llama 3 Community License Agreement; a custom commercial license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh official-card and launch review confirms Meta’s nominal 8B total for the original Instruct checkpoint. Published precision is retained; this is not an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal lineage inference: Qwen3 Table 6 explicitly reports 8B activated for original Llama-3-8B Base. Meta documents Instruct as post-training of the pretrained model using SFT/RLHF and related preference methods; the original shared dense implementation and text-only card show no documented structural change defeating that inheritance. The 8B value applies Qwen’s benchmark convention through this explicit lineage, rather than equating dense total and active by assumption. No exact original-Instruct active table or per-token tensor census was established.

architecture.note: Original launch documentation establishes decoder-only Transformer with GQA; original reference code directly executes dense feed-forward layers without an expert router.

context_window.note: The original inference README explicitly gives a maximum of 8192 tokens; later Llama 3.1 context extensions do not apply.

modalities.note: The card specifies text-only input and text/code output; code is represented as text.

reasoning.note: General reasoning improvements are discussed, but no dedicated reasoning/thinking mode is documented for this original checkpoint; benchmarks do not establish that capability flag.

tool_call.note: Meta’s Table 1 explicitly marks Tool use absent for the original Llama 3 8B Instruct row. This concerns native model support, not possible third-party prompting wrappers.

description.value: Meta’s original Llama 3 8B instruction-tuned text model, aligned for dialogue using supervised fine-tuning and RLHF, with a dense decoder-only Transformer, grouped-query attention and an 8,192-token context.
description.note: Expanded the baseline description with source-supported tuning, architecture and context details for the original checkpoint.

patch.description: Meta’s original Llama 3 8B instruction-tuned text model, aligned for dialogue using supervised fine-tuning and RLHF, with a dense decoder-only Transformer, grouped-query attention and an 8,192-token context.
patch.notes: 8B total is Meta’s nominal specification. Nominal 8B active is inferred through Meta’s documented Instruct post-training lineage from Qwen’s explicit original Llama-3-8B Base activated-count table; it is not a Meta per-token tensor census. Original April 2024 context is 8192 tokens, with no native tool use in Meta’s retrospective table.

sources.label: Qwen original Llama 3 base activated-count convention, Table 6

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained Meta’s nominal 8B total and established nominal 8B active as a clearly labeled lineage inference from Qwen3 Table 6’s explicit original Llama-3-8B Base activated count. Reopened Meta’s exact Instruct card, original release and shared implementation; their post-training description shows no documented pruning, distillation, expert expansion or added modality. Fresh exact-Instruct searches, Qwen2 Table 8 and the Yuan comparison did not establish an unambiguous direct Instruct active-count table. Meta does not supply an exact per-token census here. The other twelve assessments are preserved.
